assumptions.assumption: Federal Register Public Inspection filings give at least 24-48 hours of advance visibility before BIS or USTR rule changes take legal effect.
assumptions.test: Verify every tracked RIN / docket against both regular publication and special-filing Public Inspection timestamps.

assumptions.assumption: An official reference exchange rate reflects what people actually pay for dollars. Where a parallel market exists, the official rate understates stress.
assumptions.test: Compare against a parallel-rate source for any country where one is found.

assumptions.assumption: The markets and commodities WFP reports for a country are steady enough from month to month that the median change is comparable over time.
assumptions.test: Track the count of price series per country per month; flag a month where it falls by a third.
